54.97217,-2.10267: The Priory Gate-House (St. Wilfrid's Gateway) This gate-house is on the site of part of Wilfrid's Great Cathedral (674-680) destroyed by the Danes in 821. Listed Grade II and standing in a Conservation Area, the present station was restored in 1998/1999.
